readBundleFolder: parse a COLMAP bundle.out file to extract camera poses, intrinsics, and image paths
CatacausticsDataset_read_meta: load camera poses, intrinsics, and image paths from bundle folders for train, validation, and test splits
CatacausticsDataset_prepare_train_data: collect and concatenate all training ray coordinates and RGB values into tensors
CatacausticsDataset_get_coords: compute ray origins and directions for a given camera index using intrinsics and poses
CatacausticsDataset_getitem: return a batch dict with coords, rgb, pose, and weight for the given split and index
